name: Positioning Custom Model-Blend Tool
description: Add a 'Custom' model blend to the Positioning page so advisors can build a client-specific mix of Opal's 5 model portfolios (UST/ST/INT/LTC/LTA) and see the resulting allocation, characteristics, and combined holdings -- replacing a manual per-row calculator (Yang: 'a huge relief for their workflow'). Two parts: (A) PositioningSummary gets a Custom column (6th) on the equity/FI bars + matrix with a DUAL-INPUT control -- Mode A: allocate 100% across the 5 models -> weighted-avg blend; Mode B: enter a target equity % -> interpolate implied model weights against the BENCHMARK view (stable per-model equity anchors, avoids market-drift); guardrail weights-sum-to-100 (warn+red else). (B) HoldingsTab gets a 'CSM' selector option that reuses the existing AGG AUM-weighted aggregation but weighted by the advisor's custom model weights, plus a weights column. Both Cottonwood AND Inflection want it (Yang, call 2026-07-10). GROUNDED FE-ONLY + SOVEREIGN-CLEAN: the 5 models come from Yang's Bloomberg PKL -> generate_positioning_json.py -> positioning_data.json (Opal model data, NOT bd/49F/Schwab custody); the blend is a client-side weighted average over already-served per-model allocations/characteristics/holdings + benchmark values -- no backend/DS/Lambda/S3 change (Andrew: 'the logic is already there, it just needs a new UI element'). Key architectural change: lift the custom-blend state to Positioning.tsx so the top summary bar drives the bottom holdings CSM view (they have no shared state today). User-scoped persistence explicitly DEFERRED (Andrew+Yang: reset-on-login is fine for now, 'don't make it too complicated').
